title: biarum angustatum
intro: Biarum angustatum, commonly known as the Narrow-leaved Biarum or Devil's Dung, is a species of flowering plant in the family Colchicaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Biarum angustatum are attributed to its ability to act as a demulcent, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular remedy in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
